lines.text: Asaph calls God's people to sing, play the tambourine, harp and lyre, and sound the ram's horn at the New Moon.
God made the feast a statute for Israel, a testimony for Joseph in Egypt, when He freed their hands from the basket.
God rescued His people when they called in distress, answered from the cloud of thunder, and tested them at Massah.
God forbids a strange god among them, yet His people would not listen, so He gave them up to their stubborn hearts.
If Israel followed His ways, God would soon subdue their enemies and feed them the finest barley and honey from the rock.
